description: The camera, for the one thing a camera is for here: reading the code a computer puts on its screen. Its own file rather than five more lines in the default one, and the reason is the platform gate above them — the plugin is a dependency of the iOS target alone, so a build for this machine has no such permissions to resolve and fails on the names. Left in the default capability, that failure is `cargo test` refusing to run at all, which is how the phone's own code came to have no tests that run anywhere.
